mods.name: USB Hub Support
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: Connect multiple USB sticks to your XDJ-AZ through a USB hub.
mods.description:
PRO DJ LINK: Disable this mod and restart the AZ before using external players. Their communication is blocked while enabled; switching Link on does not disable it.

Browse and load music from USB sticks through a hub. Short-press USB STOP to select one stick; hold to eject the hub. Loaded tracks use native cached playback, which can limit player functions. Wait for 'safe to remove' before unplugging. Supports eight hub sources; firmware 2.00 only. Uses independent loopback servers/caches, changes USB STOP, writes temporary state, and loads a checked GPL kernel module.
